ns2:course.label: Orientation to Internship
ns2:course.description: Prepares students for the RST Internship (RST 485). Topics include placement requirements and policies, resume preparation, interviewing skills, acquiring letters of application, and the roles and issues of professional practice. 1 undergraduate hour. No graduate credit.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Recreation, Sport, and Tourism major(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
